💪 Build: Soft Build
Rounded proportions with minimal visible muscle definition. A body that looks comfortable rather than athletic — smooth contours without hard edges.

🖼️ Portrait only: changes how your character looks, never your Quirk or stats.
Soft Build.traitNarrativeEffects:
Portrait: Soft frame — rounded edges, gentle proportions, minimal visible muscle definition. The body reads comfortable and unhardened, surfaces smooth. Female: shoulders rounded above a full waist, soft neck, rounded jaw and chin, a full chest line above a rounded waist. Male: shoulders rounded, full neck, soft jaw, a soft flat chest over a rounded middle. Otherwise (a Mutant body plan): the character's own structure with rounded edges.

Visual selection only: keep the character's actual adult age, body plan and any Mutant features; never change anatomy to fit this choice. It adds no Quirk effect, injury, item, license or affiliation.
